h1: Custom Buttons, Stickers & Patches in Any Shape
metaTitle: Custom Buttons Stickers Patches | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom-shaped buttons, stickers & patches for your brand. Perfect Imprints offers unique shapes for bulk orders.
introHtml: Custom-shaped buttons, stickers, and patches let you break away from standard circles and rectangles. Whether you need heart-shaped pride buttons, square lapel pins, or die-cut stickers that follow your logo outline, choosing a custom shape makes your promotional items stand out. These are ideal for events, employee recognition, or retail packaging where a unique silhouette reinforces brand identity. Decorate with full-color print or foil stamping for added impact.
heroAltText: Assortment of custom shaped buttons stickers and patches in various unique silhouettes for branding
